name: Trebu
long_description: Trebu is an AI coworker for road freight. Tendering and tracking loads still run on emails, calls and WhatsApp messages between shippers, brokers and carriers. Trebu reads those messages, pulls out load details, matches loads to carriers and handles the back-and-forth until each load is covered. Once a truck is moving, Trebu monitors the shipment, follows up with drivers and flags delays or incidents before they become problems. Ops teams move more freight with fewer people, and every load is tracked in one place from tender to delivery.
one_liner: AI coworker that automates freight tendering and shipment monitoring…
